en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply on 2026-10-15
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 7 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits added an alias note to the agents docs and fixed daily commit attribution so non-GitHub-account emails are recognized. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, one own commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. On issues, the user opened 1 and closed 1 in `openchamber/openchamber`, and commented on 2: opened `#4920` about the Context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%, closed `#4346` about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`, and commented on `#4111` about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes that make `git worktree remove --force` fail with Permission denied. The user also joined discussion `#4821` in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel". No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded that day.

zh.headline: 2026-10-15：3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 当天在两个仓库共完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 7 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别为 agents 文档的口径段补充了提交归属别名说明，并修复了 daily 提交归属以支持别名、兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次本人提交发布了 `v1.15.5`。issue 方面，用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 1 个、关闭 1 个，并评论了 2 个：新开 `#4920`，指出 Context 面板的 breakdown 条把整段会话估算除以最后一条消息的输入，导致 `其他` 始终为 0%；关闭 `#4346`，涉及 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍能通过；并评论了 `#4111`，关于删除 multi-run 会留下孤立的 MCP 子进程，导致 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied。用户还参与了 `openchamber/openchamber` 中题为 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" 的讨论 `#4821`。当天没有 PR、review 或 release 记录。
